name: How can I prioritize my wish list for a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I prioritize my wish list for a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by identifying must-haves, nice-to-haves, and long-term wants, then focus first on layout improvements, structural and system upgrades, and core finishes that will have the biggest daily impact.
